item.title: About
item.description: Hi, I’m Daniel! I am a 5th year Computer Science undergraduate at Rochester Institute of Technology and I’m currently in my final semester of classes! In my free time, I enjoy exercise, video games, and problem solving. I’m always open to learning new technologies and improving my critical thinking skills. I’m currently looking for full-time employment as a backend or fullstack software engineer and will be available to work starting in January.
